fact: RTS reports that the communications and digital minister relaunched works on the Parc des Technologies Numériques at Diamniadio, whose first phase of 12.5 hectares is to include three ICT towers for tech firms and startups, an incubation centre and a research centre, with phase one due by March 2026.
Senegal and the Gates Foundation launched the Senegal AI Scaling Hub in Dakar on 29 October 2026 to bring together researchers, startups, firms and students; no programme or cohort is stated.
News Day says the Parc technologique numérique is being finalised.

AIMS Senegal says its AIMS Jëmmal Incubator at the Dakar campus ran a first cohort of 13 startups in seven sectors from March to September 2026, ending with a Demo Day, and closed the cohort on 30 October 2026.

EtriLabs, an innovation hub based in Senegal and Benin, announced on 20 June 2024 the first cohort of six EdTech startups in its Mastercard Foundation EdTech Fellowship acceleration programme in Senegal.
The directory says CTIC Dakar runs pre-incubation, incubation and acceleration programmes, and Orange Digital Center runs 6 to 9 month startup programmes.
The directory says Teranga Tech Incub runs a 6-month incubation programme deployed in Dakar, Saint-Louis, Kaolack and Ziguinchor.

An African Development Bank report dated 10 November 2026, relayed by Seneweb, says the Diamniadio Digital Technology Park is 86.4% complete across its four main works contracts, its training centre about 55%, and it remains unfinished and not operational.
